::: {.why}
The squared daily return is a one-observation estimate of a daily variance, and using the intraday path instead is the single largest accuracy improvement available in volatility forecasting.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Say why realised variance from 5-minute returns is a far better estimate of daily variance than the squared daily return, in terms of estimator variance.
- Name the two biases that appear as the sampling frequency increases, and say which direction each pushes the estimate.
